list.name: node_id
list.label: Node
list.query: SELECT name AS __text, id AS __value FROM nodes ORDER BY name

targets.rawSql: SELECT recorded_at AS time, cpu_percent AS value FROM metric_samples WHERE node_id = '$node_id' AND $__timeFilter(recorded_at) ORDER BY recorded_at
SELECT recorded_at AS time, 100.0 * memory_used_bytes / NULLIF(memory_total_bytes, 0) AS value FROM metric_samples WHERE node_id = '$node_id' AND $__timeFilter(recorded_at) ORDER BY recorded_at
SELECT recorded_at AS time, 100.0 * disk_used_bytes / NULLIF(disk_total_bytes, 0) AS value FROM metric_samples WHERE node_id = '$node_id' AND $__timeFilter(recorded_at) ORDER BY recorded_at
SELECT recorded_at AS time, load_1, load_5, load_15 FROM metric_samples WHERE node_id = '$node_id' AND $__timeFilter(recorded_at) ORDER BY recorded_at
SELECT recorded_at AS time, network_rx_bytes AS received, network_tx_bytes AS transmitted FROM metric_samples WHERE node_id = '$node_id' AND $__timeFilter(recorded_at) ORDER BY recorded_at
SELECT uptime_seconds AS value FROM metric_samples WHERE node_id = '$node_id' ORDER BY recorded_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - last_seen_at)) AS value FROM nodes WHERE id = '$node_id'
